title: Lanterns of Aldermere · Chapter One Trailer | HD-2D Pixel RPG, Free in Your Browser
author: EdgarDruin
selftext:
I'd started claude with what I thought was a fixed task, fed it a screenshot of pixel-art I'd seen and asked for a engine test, a "can we make something like this?" prompt and asked to pair it with a level editor.  

For open ended tasks like this with very short prompts, I'll typically use xhigh or max with fable or lately opus 5.5 models to orchestrate the task. For this one, I had a reset coming, so I stuck it on ultracode, told Opus 5.5 it it was to serve as orchestrator for as many subagents as it wanted for the task and went to bed.

In the morning, it had built out a full first chapter of a game based around a single screenshot.  I played it through quite a few times now, cleaned up some rough edges with feedback to claude, made sure all the quests and storylines actually worked and then added it to itch so others can play it.

Lanterns of Aldermere is a turn-based RPG in the HD-2D style: pixel-art characters in a 3D world with depth of field, lamplight and drifting fireflies.

The Great Lantern above the village of Bramblehollow has gone dark, and the Lanternkeeper is missing. Kael and Mira follow the trail through Whisperwood and down into the Sunken Sanctum, and they pick up two companions on the way.
